response.sql:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescopes
), station_avgs AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.station_avg AS average_bandwidth_usage,
       s.station_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_average
FROM station_avgs AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.station_avg > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY excess_over_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is computed across all non-NULL telescope bandwidth usage values, so each telescope contributes equally.
